query: Please implement a form parsing tool website for bulk processing of spreadsheet files. The website should have functionalities for uploading spreadsheet files, parsing spreadsheet data, converting data formats, and downloading conversion results. Users should be able to upload multiple spreadsheet files, select the data format for parsing and conversion, process spreadsheet files in bulk, and download the processed results. Use wheat for container backgrounds and chocolate for component visuals.
